title: About
text:
I completed my undergraduate studies in Computer Science and Biology at McGill University in 2021 and are pursing master degreed of Data Science (MDS) program at University of British Columbia
After graduation, I worked as a software engineer at FinTech companies, Block and StraitsX for 3 years. These experiences developed my interest in data, problem-solving, and building practical solutions. Through the MDS program, I hope to strengthen my analytical skills and learn how to apply them to real-world problems.

title: About
text:
Why data science
My experience in software development made me interested in how data can be used to better understand users, solve problems, and support decision-making. I joined the MDS program to develop stronger skills in statistics, data analysis, and machine learning, and to combine my software engineering background with data science.

title: About
text:
Outside of data science
I enjoy exploring new places, trying different foods, and spending time with friends. I recently started learning ice skate! If anyone would like to skate together at UBC, feel free to reach out. I’d love to have some skating buddies!

title: Yuxue Zhu
text: Hi! I’m a software developer currently pursuing the Master of Data Science (MDS) program at the University of British Columbia. With experience in full-stack and backend development, I’m expanding my skills in data analysis, statistics, and machine learning. I’m looking to transition my software engineering background into a career in data science or data engineering, where I can build data-driven solutions to solve real-world problems.
